entries.claim: Institutional ICs converge on ~5-9 voting seats and structurally separate deal team from credit/risk (three-lines-of-defense).
entries.notes: Historical governance grounding; supports core-7 roster + advocate!=scrutineer.

entries.claim: A minimum-complete lending IC needs 7 core seats + a Chair/Gap-Hunter so no risk category is unowned.
entries.notes: 7-seat map derived from the 16-risk coverage table; gap-hunter is a standing meta-role.

entries.claim: The 16 CRE risk categories map to owning disciplines across three tiers (deal-intrinsic, judgment-heavy, beyond-deal).
entries.notes: Coverage map is the backbone of the zero-uncovered-category metric.

entries.claim: Fund-level concentration is invisible to any deal-scoped review; OCC/FDIC require it assessed at portfolio level.
entries.notes: Justifies a fund-scoped Portfolio seat with loan-tape access; else silent PASS.

entries.claim: Financial-statement/valuation fraud is the most-repeated deal killer and by default nobody's job (ROCO; FinCEN advisory).
entries.notes: Motivates an explicit adversarial Fraud-Forensics mandate ('assume fabricated until corroborated').

entries.claim: Insurance shifted from a closing checkbox to a live underwriting variable; non-renewal/premium spikes break DSCR.
entries.notes: Merge insurance + physical-climate into one seat with underwriting authority.

entries.claim: Valuation is a 3-discipline reconciliation (sales-comp, income-cap, cost/book); one seat inherits single-approach bias.
entries.notes: Auto-escalate on material variance between approaches.

entries.claim: Independence-first (isolated opening verdict, zero cross-visibility) is the single highest-leverage anti-groupthink lever.
entries.notes: Wisdom-of-crowds needs uncorrelated errors; discussion-before-judgment destroys independence (Kahneman MAP).

entries.claim: Sycophancy is large, robust, RLHF-native: ~58% (SycEval); 63.7% agreement with an asserted incorrect belief.
entries.notes: Design assumption, not edge case; forbid agreement-without-new-evidence; derive confidence.

entries.claim: Same-model ensembles share correlated errors (0.679 vs 0.396 cross-family); 10 same-model agents ~ 1.4 independent forecasters.
entries.notes: Default to model-class/family + persona diversity; emit reduced-independence flag when single-provider.

entries.claim: Multi-agent debate does NOT reliably beat voting on accuracy and induces a martingale; consensus is not evidence of correctness.
entries.notes: Never terminate on consensus; hide mid-debate confidence; verdict computed structurally not by debate.

entries.claim: Debaters get MORE overconfident as they argue (72.9%->83% mean win-prob); IC judgment has no ground truth.
entries.notes: Lean on structural guardrails (independence, diversity, falsification), not 'more debate = better'.

entries.claim: Pre-mortem raises reasons-for-failure ~30% vs 'what could go wrong'; reasons written silently first, then round-robin.
entries.notes: Mandatory pre-mortem/inversion round before any holistic verdict.

entries.claim: MAP: decompose into fixed independent dimensions and estimate-talk-estimate before the deal-level verdict.
entries.notes: Lock the verdict field until all dimensions are populated; single highest-leverage decision-hygiene mechanic.

entries.claim: Reference-class forecasting: inside-view forecasts show 50-100% median overrun; RCF-adjusted land within 10-20%.
entries.notes: Require sponsor projections reconciled against an empirical base rate (default rate, LGD, time-to-resolution).

entries.claim: Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (Heuer/CIA): matrix hypotheses x evidence; seek disconfirming evidence.
entries.notes: Each seat generates >=1 competing failure hypothesis scored consistent/inconsistent/not-addressed.

entries.claim: Assigned rotating devil's advocate (KKR/Audax) removes reputational cost; output must be falsifiable + quantified.
entries.notes: Plus a consensus-triggered 10th-man escalation on lopsided approve-leaning distributions.

entries.claim: Pre-committed kill criteria are decided before the deal is in the room and applied mechanically FIRST.
entries.notes: Run structural kill-check before narrative mitigant reasoning (where motivated reasoning creeps in).

entries.claim: acos-axiom-synthesis is a near-exact structural fit (fixture-tested, 54 assertions, Phases 0-7) - reuse, don't rebuild.
entries.notes: Engine supplies epistemics; IC skill supplies domain (seats, objection semantics, verdict vocab).

entries.claim: axiom-synthesis grades TRUTH (Axis A reliability, Axis B certainty) but has NO severity axis; add domain-owned Axis S.
entries.notes: Axis S ordinal ladder stored alongside A/B, never blended; domain-owned in the IC fact-builder (no engine change).

entries.claim: Deal-breaker is a derived deterministic rule: ESTABLISHED/CORROBORATED AND severity>=material AND no surviving mitigant.
entries.notes: Keeps 'is it true' (engine, mechanical) separate from 'is it fatal' (domain, computed after truth settles).

entries.claim: Overall verdict = one resolve_conflict() over per-discipline roll-ups; asymmetric-veto on deal-breakers; UNRESOLVED terminal.
entries.notes: Verdict computed deterministically, never narrated by an LLM; false-accept is the catastrophic error.

entries.claim: Naive LLM-aggregator (MoA) blends/arbitrates away disagreement; route same-fact conflicts through resolve_conflict() instead.
entries.notes: Audit Critical Divergence Points, do not vote-blend; preserves dissent.

entries.claim: Subagents categorically cannot call AskUserQuestion/ExitPlanMode; only the main conversation can pause for a live human.
entries.notes: Mode B moderator MUST be the top-level SKILL.md; no nested agent owns the human-pausing loop.

entries.claim: ACOS already has a validated pause-for-human idiom: bounce a structured request up, persist to disk, re-dispatch (fin-stmt-accountant).
entries.notes: Reuse for human injection; dr2 votes-as-JSON + consensus_check.py is the deterministic-tally precedent.

entries.claim: Transcript-as-source-of-truth (every turn hits disk immediately) survives /clear, crash, and Eternity handoff.
entries.notes: Resume reads manifest.yaml + round-status.yaml to re-enter at last-closed round.

entries.claim: autopilot-active silently auto-answers the pause AskUserQuestion (autopilot-askuserquestion-handler.py) - a real HITL hazard.
entries.notes: Detect the state file; refuse deep-pause or fall back to batch mode; make (Recommended) safe under auto-pick.

entries.claim: Present Mode B as a moderated relay / structured written deposition, not a fake real-time room (Claude Code is turn-based).
entries.notes: Discrete skimmable turn blocks + clean pause points are strengths; scoreboard reprints compensate for no sidebar.

entries.claim: Chair authority is procedural, not evidentiary: agents update-with-a-named-new-fact or hold-with-a-reason, never capitulate.
entries.notes: An IC exists to catch a human railroading a deal under closing pressure; deference-because-human is theater.

entries.claim: Legal seat = reuse legal-analyst (A1-A8) via /acos-legal-analysis --mode lending; re-project red-flags.yaml into voting format.
entries.notes: Duplicating risks drift between two frameworks giving different verdicts.

entries.claim: legal-analyst has NO usury/licensing, AML/KYC, foreclosure-mechanics, or committee-fiduciary module - a compliance companion covers the four gaps.
entries.notes: Per-deal jurisdiction check (Utah Commercial Financing Registration; business-purpose usury exemption).

entries.claim: CERCLA secured-lender protection is conditional/time-boxed; Phase I must conform to ASTM E1527-21 (mandatory since 2024-02-13).
entries.notes: Add a Phase I currency/staleness gate; unaddressed RECs w/o Phase II = deal-breaker, curable by update.

entries.claim: SEC 2026 exam priorities put private-credit fiduciary duty + conflicts disclosure top of agenda - a PROCESS discipline.
entries.notes: Emit a per-run conflicts-disclosure.yaml evidencing the committee's own process was sound.

entries.claim: IC memos converge on ~10-13 canonical sections built on the 5 C's; risks written as a bound Risk->Mitigant->Residual triplet with CP tagging.
entries.notes: Mitigant caps not erases; residual mandatory even on approved deals; each CP tagged to the risk it retires.

entries.claim: Severity language: plain-English 4-tier Monitor/Mitigated/Material-Conditioned/Disqualifying mapped to FATAL/MATERIAL/MINOR and OCC Pass/SM/Substandard/Doubtful/Loss.
entries.notes: De-jargonized for a PE-RE audience; deal-breaker is category-specific (structurally curable? test).

entries.claim: No public precedent exists for terminal CLI, human-chaired, multi-agent financial debate, or MAD on a no-ground-truth IC judgment - greenfield.
entries.notes: Ship reasoned defaults (round cap 5-6, turn 150-250w, checkpoint every 3); pilot-and-instrument, don't assume.
